name: Transportation Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public transportation data.

entries.title: UNCTADstat
entries.description: UN Trade and Development's statistical database covering maritime transport, merchant fleets, liner shipping connectivity, and freight volumes alongside its broader trade and economy indicators.
entries.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). ITF-OECD (International Transport Forum), the other natural international transport-statistics body, returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge on direct fetch — same block class as almanac-template#2. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: U.S. DOT Open Data Portal (data.transportation.gov)
entries.description: The Department of Transportation's open data catalog, hosting datasets from DOT operating administrations — border crossings, vehicle recalls, safety, and more — with Socrata-based APIs and downloads.
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page shows featured datasets (border crossing data, Takata recall priority groups) and links to the Socrata Terms of Use. It is a portal, not one dataset, so it's cataloged as a gateway; individual DOT datasets deserve their own entries. Some DOT bureau sites returned Access Denied to both curl and headless Chromium this session (NHTSA FARS, the FTA National Transit Database, BTS freight pages), and this portal may be the most reliable programmatic route to some of their data. The license is marked dataset-dependent because individual datasets can carry their own terms.
